supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Visible extension of the ridge boundary beyond the lateral ocular canthi

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Uniformly low intensity/dark pigmentation across muzzle, cheek, and periocular regions with minimal detectable contrast

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin vertical profile with a neutral horizontal orientation and no structural droop

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: Rounded apex on the visible right pinna; left pinna partially occluded

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive circular patch of light-colored depigmentation or sparse hair on the upper central forehead/cranium
